## How it Works
1. **Search**: Enter your location and the type of service you need (e.g., "Surveillance in London").
2. **Compare**: View profiles, read verified reviews, and check pricing.
3. **Contact**: Message detectives directly through our secure platform.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
### How do I verify a private investigator?
All detectives on Ask Detectives undergo a strict verification process including license checks, identity verification, and business registration review. Look for the "Verified" badge on profiles.

### Is it free to use Ask Detectives?
Yes, searching and contacting detectives is completely free for clients. We do not charge booking fees to users.

### Is my search confidential?
Absolutely. Your search history and inquiries are private. We do not share your details with detectives until you choose to contact them.

## For Users
- [Search Detectives](https://www.askdetectives.com/search): Filter by location, service type, and budget.
- [Service Categories](https://www.askdetectives.com/categories): Browse investigators by specialization.
- [How it Works](https://www.askdetectives.com/about): Learn about our verification process.

## For Detectives
- [Join Network](https://www.askdetectives.com/detective-signup): Apply to list your services.
- [Claim Profile](https://www.askdetectives.com/claim-account): Claim an existing agency listing.

## Trust & Safety
All detectives on Ask Detectives undergo a verification process. We prioritize privacy and secure communication.
